About the Zombie Virus:
This virus differs from ordinary infections. The zombie virus primarily spreads through biting. Once a human is bitten, there is no cure unless the bitten limb is amputated immediately. Otherwise, the infected person will "resurrect" as a zombie. A person must be bitten within a certain period after death to "resurrect," as the virus only affects the nervous system of the brain. It can control the zombie's bodily movements, biting actions, hearing, and vision. To kill a zombie, one must destroy its head; any other body part will have no effect. The virus only affects humans and has no impact on animals or plants. The chances of infection are 7% for scratches, 25% for lacerations, and 100% for bites.
